newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: ENERGY AFRICA SELLS STAKE IN OMAN FIELD.
newsitem.headline: ENERGY AFRICA SELLS STAKE IN OMAN FIELD.

text.p: Energy Africa Ltd said on Tuesday it had sold to Heritage Oil and Gas Ltd its 100 percent shareholding in Eagle Energy (Oman) Ltd which holds a 10 percent interest in the offshore Bukha gas condensate field.
Heritage is paying $7.4 million, with an additional consideration payable in the event that the West Bukha (or Henjam) field enters into production.
The Bukha field commenced production in April 1994 and currently produces approximately 500 barrels a day of condensate and natural gas liquids net to Eagle Energy (Oman).
Commenting on the deal, Energy Africa managing director John Bentley said:
"The interests in Oman were no longer of strategic value to Energy Africa and the funds received will be put towards the company's growth opportunities in Africa."
